mapper.insert: insert into workplace(work_id, work_name, work_ceonm, work_no, work_cond, work_item, work_tel, work_fax, work_addr, work_mainadd, work_detailadd, work_manname, work_manemail, work_mantel) VALUES (#{work_id}, #{work_name}, #{work_ceonm}, #{work_no}, #{work_cond}, #{work_item}, #{work_tel}, #{work_fax}, #{work_addr}, #{work_mainadd}, #{work_detailadd},#{work_manname}, #{work_manemail}, #{work_mantel})
mapper.select: select work_id, work_name, work_ceonm, work_cond, work_item, work_tel, work_fax, work_addr, work_mainadd, work_detailadd, work_manname, work_manemail, work_mantel from workplace where work_id=#{work_id}
